text:
tia: Heads-up — enterprise rep from ACME reached out. They saw a big overage on last month's invoice (reserved pool bursted during demo). Asking if we can convert the overage $12k into platform credits for renewal if they commit to a 6-month Dedicated plan.

samir: Are they closing this week? What's current ARR / committed spend?

tia: Renewal dec 5. Current annualized spend ~ $350k. Last month overage was from demo on eu-west-1 — spike due to unthrottled parallel requests.

julia: Product input: we can offer one-off credit for retention, but want a repeatable path in product — 'burst-to-credits' claim flow + admin UI + audit trail. Otherwise ops manual is unsustainable. :thinking_face:

chao: Agree. From infra side we can detect burst origin + matching reserved pool ID. Need a metadata tag on requests to tie to account. Currently we only have token-level billing events. It'd take ~2 sprints to add tagging and an admin flow.

marta: Finance prefers credits only against future invoices, not retro refunds. Also need automated contract note so ACME legal signs off.

samir: Sales needs a fast answer. Can Product scope a short-term manual escalation + mid-term product feature? Label manual as P1, product work as P2.

julia: Proposed acceptance criteria for product ticket PRD-5071:
- Admin can create a credit (amount, reason, expiry) and attach to customer account
- Credits appear on next invoice and reduce overage line items
- Audit trail shows creator, time, and source ticket
- UI option to convert a specific invoice overage into credit
- Telemetry event for 'credit_applied' for GA metrics

julia: Quick snippet of API we might expose:
```
POST /admin/v1/credits
{
  "account_id": "acct_123",
  "amount": 12000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "reserved pool overage - demo",
  "linked_invoice": "INV-2026",
  "expires_at": "2025-06-05"
}
```

chao: Also need backend rule: credits only offset 'overage' tags, not base reserved charge. Implementation estimate: 1 sprint for API + DB, 1 sprint for UI + audit logs.

product-ops: Suggest adding an intake field to support workflow: 'credit_recommendation' with dropdown (none, partial credit, full credit) + evidence upload (logs, spike graph).

marta: OK but require a manual check before applying > $5k. Anything below $5k can auto-approve by product-ops.

samir: I'll tell ACME we can do a one-time credit pending contract note. tia, can you open a support escalation and tag PRD-5071? Also flag renewal owner.

tia: On it. Opening escalation now. Escalation#: SE-3321. Assigning to @julia and @marta.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026 created for acct_123 — total $48,321 — overage $12,000.

julia: Thanks. I'll draft the PRD and timeline: manual process today; API+DB in ~2 weeks; UI+audit in ~5 weeks. Will post PRD-5071 link here when ready.

samir: Perfect, appreciate the quick turn.
